study.question: Does normalizing target-aware history evidence separately within genuine behavior types help beyond global attention and a capacity/count-matched displaced-label partition, under the same causal histories and training recipe?
study.hypothesis: Observed source limitation: one global softmax forces four behavior types into a common mass budget and one small summary. Provisional mechanism: when a useful action has low global attention mass, an action-specific conditional summary can expose its target-relevant content to the field MLP. This is a hypothesis, not an observed starvation diagnosis: current evidence gives only history coverage, slice metrics and source structure. Four summaries retain behavior identity; within-group normalization removes cross-action denominator competition. Preserve the original global summary to retain its information and test routing and normalization factorially.

nearest_work.difference: Retain its field/event embeddings, query, shared activation scorer, global summary and output hidden widths. Append four grouped summaries; factorial controls have equal added capacity. Baseline comparison alone confounds the additional 8192 dense parameters and views.

Inherit target-conditioned local activation concept. Original DIN explicitly drops softmax to preserve interest intensity; the supplied reference uses softmax and additive field substitutions. This study isolates behavior routing/denominators within that adaptation and is not an exact DIN reproduction or a claim to invent target-aware attention.

study.proposed_difference: Append four summaries to the original global summary. Factor A: real action routing versus rotating only routing labels by floor(valid_history_count/2) valid events, preserving exact per-row group counts, presence, available content and model size. Factor B: per-group masked softmax versus original global-softmax weights restricted to each group, without renormalization. Keep actual event action embeddings in every cell. All four modules are standalone and share computation/parameter shapes. Empty groups return zero; no learned gates, auxiliary targets, label access, additional history or new fields. At baseline dimensions each cell adds 4*16*128=8192 dense parameters (17138467 expected total versus baseline 17130275).
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: action_local should improve full-validation AUC over action_global, with unweighted Logloss reported even if worse. Single-seed gains are preliminary. Follow directions with paired seeds 42/43/44 and paired user-cluster bootstrap only if host exposes an authorized implementation; do not substitute impression-independent uncertainty.

Semantic-normalization interaction D=(AUC(action_local)-AUC(action_global))-(AUC(displaced_local)-AUC(displaced_global)) should be positive if behavior-specific competition is the explanation. Also compare action_local to displaced_local and all four to baseline-din; baseline-only improvement does not identify a mechanism.

Candidate-supplied diagnostics on the host first-512-row validation batch should reveal whether non-pv behaviors ever receive global mass below predeclared 0.05 when present. Report presence denominators via present_fraction*512, event counts, global mass and displaced_label_change_fraction. These measurements describe a small nonrandom batch and do not establish population starvation or causal importance.

Use existing full-validation behavior-presence/absence, history-length, hour, user-frequency and category-match slices with host-reported positive/negative/sample counts. Expect stronger gain on non-pv-present and long-history slices if the proposed limitation matters, but overlapping slices are exploratory and do not directly measure within-row imbalance. Empty/single-type cases and low displacement rate limit the routing contrast.

Four cells must have identical parameter counts. Compare measured wall/GPU cost, peak memory and end-to-end throughput/p50/p95 latency. Equal epochs/data passes support mechanism comparison; no efficiency claim without measured quality-cost comparison.
falsifiers: Action_local fails to beat action_global on full validation and remains null/negative with paired repetitions when affordable: this implementation does not support the within-action normalization benefit; retain negative results.

Displaced_local improves as much as action_local, or the factorial interaction is zero/negative: group scaling/multiple summaries may explain gains; do not attribute them specifically to behavior semantics.
All four expanded cells improve similarly versus baseline-din: capacity or additional views remain the leading explanation, not within-action normalization.

On diagnostic rows there is little mixed-type support, negligible displaced-label change, or no low-mass non-pv evidence: the proposed starvation interpretation is untested or contradicted there; do not generalize to the population.

NaN logits, nonzero summaries for empty groups, changed group counts in displaced controls, history/label-boundary violations or a trial cap failure invalidate that execution. Keep its receipt and cost; implementation failure is distinct from scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Additional MLP input capacity or four summaries can improve performance independently of behavior semantics; the 2x2 controls match capacity, while baseline comparisons do not.

Normalization changes activation scale, gradient allocation and removes group mass/count information; gains may be optimization effects rather than recovery of useful rare-action evidence. Original global summary limits information loss but does not remove this ambiguity.

Displaced labels preserve counts and presence but can remain correlated with true labels or temporal clusters; low within-row action diversity weakens the placebo. They also alter recency/content grouping. Report displacement rate; this is not a perfect randomized causal control.
Marginal action presence rates and baseline slice differences can reflect user/population differences or prevalence, not event frequency or individual causal relevance.

One training seed and first-512-row diagnostics are insufficient for robust generalization. Host static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented; this benchmark does not establish production point-in-time validity.
The global-mass controls could learn useful behavior intensity that local summaries remove; a candidate loss can support that alternative without refuting multi-behavior modeling generally.
